title: Columbo
description:
S4 E4 — Troubled Waters
Columbo's Mexico cruise is disrupted when an automobile executive kills his blackmailing lover, the ship's singer, then frames a musician.

title: Columbo
description:
S4 E5 — Playback
After killing his mother-in-law, an electronics magnate's alibi is a video security system.

title: Columbo
description:
S4 E6 — A Deadly State of Mind
A psychiatrist (George Hamilton) romances a wealthy patient (Lesley Ann Warren) then uses her in his alibi after killing her husband (Stephen Elliott).

title: Columbo
description:
S5 E1 — Forgotten Lady
A retired actress/dancer stages her wealthy husband's suicide after he refuses to finance her Broadway comeback.

title: Columbo
description:
S5 E2 — A Case of Immunity
A foreign dignitary murders his rival then disguises the crime as part of a robbery blamed on college protesters.

title: Columbo
description:
S5 E3 — Identity Crisis
A cunning advertising consultant leading a double life as a spy tries to cover up the details of a homicide.

title: Columbo
description:
S5 E4 — A Matter of Honor
A retired bullfighter credited with saving a young man from a bull arranges the death of the boy's father to protect his own reputation.

title: Columbo
description:
S5 E5 — Now You See Him
A magician claims an airtight alibi -- being sealed in a tank of water -- in the murder of a blackmailing associate.

title: Columbo
description:
S5 E6 — Last Salute to the Commodore
Lt. Columbo's prime suspect in the case of a drowned yacht magnate also turns up dead.

title: Columbo
description:
S6 E1 — Fade In to Murder
An egotistic TV detective matches wits with Columbo after murdering his producer, a former lover and current blackmailer.

title: Columbo
description:
S6 E2 — Old-Fashioned Murder
The curator (Joyce Van Patten) of a strapped family-owned museum stages a robbery, for insurance, then murders to hide her crime; guests Celeste Holm, Tim O'Connor.

title: Columbo
description:
S6 E3 — The Bye-Bye Sky-High IQ Murder Case
An accountant, embezzling to support his wife's lifestyle, murders his partner after the man discovers his crimes.

title: Columbo
description:
S7 E3 — Make Me a Perfect Murder
A TV-network executive murders her boss and lover when he fails to promote her.
